endorsements.name: Xavier Danest
endorsements.label: CVE-2022-34900
endorsements.description: This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of Parallels Access 6.5.3 (39313) Agent. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the Dispatcher service. The service loads an OpenSSL configuration file from an unsecured location. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of SYSTEM. Was ZDI-CAN-15213.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.0, 7.8)
